title: Alexandria claim list
description: The deduplicated canonical claim list for one run, stored as claims.json beside the scores.csv that scores it. Claim identity is deliberately permissive: if even one model treats something as a distinct claim it gets its own claim_id, because novelty is signal, not noise to be merged away.

claim_id.description: Stable within a run, e.g. c-001.

group.description: How the scored stances fall across responding models. Note that these groups register disagreement about DIRECTION only — two models can differ sharply about degree and still land in 'consensus'.

responding_model_count.description: Models that returned output and were graded. A failed research call is not counted here and must never be coerced to a score of 0.
